episode_title: Bernadetta x Caspar C - The Scenic View
source_summary: Bernadetta panics when Caspar appears; Caspar concludes outside friendship is easy and carries her to a beautiful view, terrifying her before she admits the scenery is lovely.

characters.name: Caspar
characters.identity_lock: Academy-era Caspar: youthful compact build, short pale-blue tousled hair, direct earnest face, Black Eagles black academy uniform with red cape and house sleeve patch; urgent body language but controlled mouth and eyes, never a mature bulky strongman.

characters.name: Bernadetta
characters.identity_lock: Academy-era Bernadetta: short purple hair, small guarded posture, anxious but readable eyes, Black Eagles academy uniform; comic nervousness through posture and hesitation, not horror and not meme-faced.

frame_intents.start: Caspar sets Bernadetta down at a monastery overlook glowing with sunset.
frame_intents.key: Bernadetta wobbles dramatically, half-dazed, while Caspar points at the sky.
frame_intents.end: Bernadetta finally looks out and softens into wonder.

dialogue.speaker: Caspar
dialogue.text: よっしゃー！ 着いたな！ どうよ、この景色。

dialogue.speaker: Bernadetta
dialogue.text: 死んだ……あたし、死にました……。すごい勢いで天地を駆け抜けました……。

dialogue.speaker: Bernadetta
dialogue.text: ああ……お迎えが来てます……。魂が洗われるような夕焼けです……。

dialogue.speaker: Caspar
dialogue.text: おい！ 逝くな、ベルナデッタ！ あの夕焼けは本物だ！

dialogue.speaker: Bernadetta
dialogue.text: あ、でも、すごく綺麗……。素敵な場所ですね、ここ！

primary_check: Pay off panic as Bernadetta recognizes the view is genuinely beautiful.
